description: Högsta kustlinjen is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sveriges geologiska undersökning. The information provides a basis for assessing soil characteristics such as the composition and structure of soil types, as well as for modelling landscape development (paleogeography) and land elevation. Coverage: Sveriges geologiska undersökning. The portal shows the English title as "Highest coastline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sveriges geologiska undersökning. Its keywords include HVD. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, ZIP, PDF. The listing shows 2024-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
